answers.question: If I report here, who finds out?
answers.answer: Both the Complainant and the Respondent are informed if the Director of Investigations determines that they have jurisdiction to investigate. They also receive regular progress updates throughout the process, including when the investigator completes their written report of the investigation findings.

citations.quote: 2.3.2 informing the Complainant and the Respondent if the Director of Investigations determines that they have Jurisdiction to Investigate; and
2.3.3 informing the Complainant and the Respondent when the Investigator completes their written report of the Investigation Findings.
